title: The Conscript
_note: A1.3: the boy with the spear. Killing him adds Collateral. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

start.speaker: Conscript
start.text: [He drops the knife. He is about sixteen.] Please. They said it was just the tax. They said nobody would fight. I'm from Tava's Blessing, I'm not one of them, please.

choices.spoken: Go home. Tell your mother you were never here.
